Enum Class AuthResponseCode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<AuthResponseCode>
org.springframework.security.extension.exception.AuthResponseCode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<AuthResponseCode>, Constable
public enum AuthResponseCode extends Enum<AuthResponseCode>
Enumeration of response codes used by the authentication and authorisation layers of the easy-4-java security stack.

Every constant combines three pieces of information:

  • an integer code that follows the API code convention defined in ApiCodeValue;
  • a status string drawn from AuthConstants (success, fail or error);
  • a message key that the caller can resolve against an internationalised resource bundle.
Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)
